title: Kimura–O'Sullivan Finite-Dimensionality Conjecture
exact_target: Can every smooth projective variety's rational motive be split into an even part with a vanishing exterior power and an odd part with a vanishing symmetric power?

sources.citation: Motifs de dimension finie [d'après S.-I. Kimura, P. O'Sullivan, ...]; Bourbaki929,March2004; Astérisque299(2005),115–145.
